class.name: XboxNetworkingSecurityInformation
class.brief_description: Network Security Allow List (NSAL) information for a title endpoint.

method.name: get_enabled_http_security_protocol_flags
method.description: Returns the bitmask of HTTP security protocols the NSAL entry enables for the URL ([code]XNetworkingSecurityInformation::enabledHttpSecurityProtocolFlags[/code]).

method.name: get_thumbprints
method.description: Returns one [Dictionary] per certificate thumbprint, each with [code]type: int[/code] (one of [enum XboxNetworking.ThumbprintType]), [code]type_name: String[/code] ([code]leaf[/code], [code]issuer[/code], or [code]root[/code]), [code]bytes: PackedByteArray[/code], and [code]hex: String[/code] (lowercase hex encoding of [code]bytes[/code]).

method.name: to_dictionary
method.description: Returns the whole record as a [Dictionary] with [code]enabled_http_security_protocol_flags: int[/code] and [code]thumbprints: Array[/code].
